_DOCTRINE: Report mechanics, never make the call. check-noconnect exit 0 before import. A null fact DELETES its sentence. No drift-prone value in a title, heading or excerpt.
_WHY: The corpus hedges the licence question and never resolves it: 'a US license is generally accepted for short visits, though an IDP is recommended', 'recommended and sometimes required'. Four different thresholds exist — what Turkish law requires, what the rental desk asks, what the insurer requires, and what an IDP legally is — and no free article lines them up.
_DEPTH: S-licence 1,778 -> ~6,750 dedicated words in this one batch, matching the pattern from batches 16 and 18.

articles.title: The International Driving Permit for Turkey
reports: what an IDP legally is — a translation of a licence, not a licence in itself
which US bodies are authorised to issue one and what that costs
validity period and whether it can be obtained after leaving the US
what Turkish law requires of a foreign driver, and for how long a visitor may drive on a foreign licence
that it must be carried alongside the home licence, never instead of it
articles.must_not_say: whether to get one — the four thresholds disagree and reconciling them is the book's

articles.title: Renting a Car in Turkey: What the Law Says and What the Desk Says
reports: what Turkish law actually establishes: a foreign licence is valid for six months from entry, and no IDP is mandated inside that window
that minimum age, licence-holding period, deposit, accepted documents and cross-border rules are set by each rental company's contract, not by regulation
the one statutory insurance layer — compulsory third-party liability — and what it does not cover
that collision damage waiver, excess and the exclusion list are commercial products with no regulated form
why 'what do I need to rent a car in Turkey' has no single answer, and where the answer actually lives
articles.must_not_say: a checklist presented as universal requirements, or advice on which cover to buy
articles._REPLACED: Merges the old articles 2 and 3. EVERY rental-desk fact and EVERY rental-insurance fact came back null from both panels, and both stated the same reason: these are contractual, not statutory. That absence is the article.

articles.title: Driving in Turkey: Rules, Tolls and How Fines Reach You
reports: speed limits by road type, from the official highways table
the drink-driving limit, and the lower limit for commercial and other non-private drivers
seatbelt, phone and child-restraint rules
the HGS electronic toll system and how rental cars are equipped for it
what an unpaid pass becomes, and how it is notified to the registered owner
how a fine incurred in a rental car reaches a foreign renter
articles.must_not_say: how to avoid a fine, or any figure for the toll surcharge or grace period
articles._NOTE: Best-sourced article in the batch: grok opened the official KGM speed-limit table and the Emniyet alcohol page, both of which correct values deepseek gave from memory.

articles.title: If You Have an Accident in a Rental Car in Turkey
reports: what the law requires at the scene: stopping, securing, first aid, when police must attend
the joint accident report used for material-damage-only collisions, and when vehicles may be moved
compulsory third-party liability and where its cover stops
what the rental contract's damage terms sit on top of
the documents generated at the scene and why they matter later
articles.must_not_say: whether to call the police, or whether to claim — and no insurance recommendation
articles.note: SECOND JOIN TO S-INSURE. Batch 16 established that a Turkish medical claim needs a police report where an accident was involved. This article reports what produces that report. Neither joins them.

articles.title: Scooters and ATVs in Turkey
reports: what licence category Turkish law requires for a scooter or motorcycle by engine size
whether a US car licence covers any of those categories
helmet law and enforcement
what rental operators typically ask for versus what the law requires
where ATVs and quads sit legally, on and off road
articles.must_not_say: whether to rent one; the insurance consequence is reported in the exclusions guide, not resolved here
articles.note: This is the join to S-insure. Batch 16's turkey-insurance-exclusions-activities reports the licence CONDITION inside the policy exclusion. This article reports the licence CATEGORY the law requires. Neither joins them — the book does.
